about.title: FORMIQ architecture
about.description: The Next.js application serves the interface and API. Pyworker reads documents and converts detected fields into a structured form.

identity.title: Identity and access
identity.description: Keycloak provides identity through OIDC, Better Auth manages sessions, and the server checks roles and resource access.

files.title: Files and products
files.description: Documents have metadata, versions and a controlled lifecycle. Products use a shared file catalogue while file contents remain in private object storage.

workspace.title: A consistent workspace
workspace.description: Tables, forms, notifications and navigation use shared components. Language and appearance preferences adapt the interface to the way you work.

tasks.title: Background operations
tasks.description: The queue stores tasks and manages retries. The Python executor handles defined operations; administrators can inspect the queue and service availability.

storage.title: Store the original
storage.description: The web server stores the file in SeaweedFS through the S3 API and its metadata in PostgreSQL.

queue.title: Queue the analysis
queue.description: The API returns HTTP 202 and an operation ID. The form.process job goes to the pg-boss queue.

worker.title: Read the document
worker.description: The queue consumer fetches the original from S3 and sends it to Pyworker with its metadata.

result.title: Save and export
result.description: The server saves the result in PostgreSQL. The draft field contains the COI JSON. In pipeline mode, the result also includes an intermediate model and detected field coordinates.

team.title: Development team
team.description: The people building and developing FORMIQ.

jakub.bio: Develops AI features for FORMIQ and integrates them into the user interface.

natalia.bio: Coordinates work on FORMIQ, keeps communication flowing and supports the team with day-to-day organization.

yurii.bio: Develops the FORMIQ frontend and turns AI capabilities into features users can access in the app.

stanislaw.bio: Develops the FORMIQ backend, including server-side logic and data handling.

about.intro: Originals go to object storage, results go to PostgreSQL, and the pg-boss queue handles background form processing.
about.scopeDescription: The web server manages permissions and data, and the worker analyses documents.
about.workflowDescription: Uploading a file and starting analysis are separate API operations.

architecture.label: Under the surface
architecture.title: One backend. Clear responsibilities.
architecture.description: Next.js combines the interface and backend. The database, file storage, identity provider and executors support the application through defined connections.
architecture.note: The browser communicates with the application. The backend controls access to private data and services.

technologies.database: Application data, sessions and durable task storage.
technologies.storage: Private file contents through the S3 interface.
technologies.queue: Task delivery, states and controlled retries.
technologies.python: An independent executor for processing operations.

environments.title: One project, different ways to run it
environments.description: DEV and QA share local addresses while keeping configuration and data separate. Production remains a planned stage.

dev.title: Local development
dev.description: Web and workers run on the developer workstation, with infrastructure in Docker, enabling quick feedback on code changes.

qa.title: Integration verification
qa.description: Applications run from built images. This environment verifies how services work together as a complete stack.

prod.title: Production deployment
prod.description: A separate environment, configuration and operating procedures. It requires its own validation before release.

teamCta.title: People behind the code
teamCta.description: Meet the person responsible for architecture and development direction, with space for future contributors.

processing.title: Document reading
processing.description: Pyworker configuration determines how the system reads text and detects fields.

local.title: Local processing
local.description: Docling reads PDF text, PaddleOCR recognises scans and images, and a local Qwen model running through vLLM generates the form structure.

cloud.title: Processing through Eden AI
cloud.description: In vision mode, Pyworker sends page images or locally extracted content to Qwen through Eden AI. In OCR mode, it sends scans for text recognition and generates the form structure without a language model.

authConsole.title: Keycloak Admin Console
authConsole.description: Manage users and roles in Keycloak.

keycloak.title: Keycloak OIDC configuration
keycloak.description: Find the sign-in and public key endpoints.

swagger.title: Pyworker Swagger UI
swagger.description: Explore and test the worker API endpoints.
